subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers wait for the requested reporter-provided live Socket Mode envelope/log evidence, or run a maintainer-owned Slack repro to locate the first drop boundary?
rationale: Source inspection shows multiple plausible boundaries, and the latest maintainer comment already states handler-level tests are insufficient to choose a safe fix.

options.title: Wait for requested evidence
options.body: Keep this issue open with `needs-info` until the reporter provides redacted raw envelope fields and nearby Gateway logs from current main or the newest release.

options.title: Run maintainer live repro
options.body: A maintainer can use a controlled Slack workspace to reproduce single-account and multi-account reaction events and capture the same envelope fields faster.

options.title: Defer to broader Socket Mode work
options.body: If new evidence shows this is not reaction-specific, route it to the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery issue and link the preserved details there.
